checklist_items.title: FastAPI Cơ Bản và Type Hints
checklist_items.description: Cài đặt uvicorn, route decorators, path/query/body params, Python type hints, automatic docs (/docs)
checklist_items.market_relevance: FastAPI là Python API framework nhanh nhất và phổ biến nhất hiện tại

checklist_items.title: Pydantic Models và Validation
checklist_items.description: BaseModel, Field validators, nested models, response_model, model_config, Pydantic v2 features
checklist_items.market_relevance: Pydantic là foundation của FastAPI validation và serialization

checklist_items.title: Dependency Injection với Depends()
checklist_items.description: Depends() pattern, yield dependencies (context managers), nested dependencies, class-based, caching, override trong tests
checklist_items.market_relevance: DI là core pattern của FastAPI cho clean architecture

checklist_items.title: Async/Await và Event Loop
checklist_items.description: async def vs def routes, khi nào dùng async, blocking calls trong async context, asyncio.to_thread(), uvloop
checklist_items.market_relevance: Async programming là key performance feature của FastAPI

checklist_items.title: Middleware và CORS
checklist_items.market_relevance: Middleware cho cross-cutting concerns là production requirement

checklist_items.title: Exception Handling
checklist_items.description: HTTPException, custom exception classes, @app.exception_handler(), RequestValidationError override, JSONResponse
checklist_items.market_relevance: Proper error handling là sign of professional API

checklist_items.title: SQLAlchemy Async Integration
checklist_items.description: create_async_engine, async_sessionmaker, AsyncSession, Mapped columns, relationships, selectinload, Alembic migrations
checklist_items.market_relevance: Async SQLAlchemy là production standard cho FastAPI + PostgreSQL

checklist_items.title: JWT Authentication với OAuth2
checklist_items.description: OAuth2PasswordBearer, python-jose JWT, /token endpoint, get_current_user dependency, refresh tokens, scopes
checklist_items.market_relevance: JWT auth là requirement cho protected APIs

checklist_items.title: Router Organization và Project Structure
checklist_items.description: APIRouter, prefix/tags/dependencies per router, include_router, lifespan events, modular structure
checklist_items.market_relevance: Project structure quan trọng cho scalable FastAPI apps

checklist_items.title: Testing với pytest
checklist_items.description: TestClient, AsyncClient (httpx), pytest fixtures, dependency override, database isolation, async tests với anyio
checklist_items.market_relevance: Testing là bắt buộc cho production-grade FastAPI apps

checklist_items.title: File Upload và Streaming
checklist_items.description: UploadFile, multiple files, FileResponse, StreamingResponse, validation (type/size), S3 integration, background processing

checklist_items.title: WebSocket Support
checklist_items.description: @app.websocket(), WebSocket.accept/receive/send, ConnectionManager, rooms, auth cho WebSocket connections

checklist_items.title: Background Tasks và Celery
checklist_items.description: BackgroundTasks, Celery với Redis/RabbitMQ broker, @task decorator, retry, scheduling với celery-beat, Flower monitoring
checklist_items.market_relevance: Async task processing là requirement cho production apps

checklist_items.title: Redis Caching
checklist_items.description: aioredis integration, cache middleware, TTL, cache-aside pattern, Depends(get_redis), cache invalidation strategies
checklist_items.market_relevance: Redis caching là key performance technique

checklist_items.title: Pydantic Settings và Configuration
checklist_items.description: pydantic-settings BaseSettings, @lru_cache singleton, .env file, nested settings, validation, dependency injection
checklist_items.market_relevance: Proper config management là production requirement

checklist_items.title: Production Deployment
checklist_items.description: Gunicorn + UvicornWorker, Docker multi-stage, health checks, graceful shutdown, Kubernetes HPA, HTTPS, proxy headers
checklist_items.market_relevance: Production deployment skills thiết yếu cho backend developer

checklist_items.title: Performance Optimization
checklist_items.description: asyncpg driver, connection pooling, uvloop, response caching, profiling, N+1 query prevention, batch operations
checklist_items.market_relevance: Performance optimization là senior developer skill

checklist_items.title: Observability và Security
checklist_items.description: structlog, Prometheus metrics, OpenTelemetry tracing, Sentry, OWASP API Security compliance, BOLA prevention
checklist_items.market_relevance: Observability và security thiết yếu cho production systems
